# Week 2026-W42: 5 releases, 1 needs action

_A security fix to ship now, and two platform releases to read_

## 🔴 Act now

| Release | What changed | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| [OpenTofu 1.12.8](https://github.com/opentofu/opentofu/releases/tag/v1.12.8) | Security fix: a crafted module source could read files outside the working directory. | Upgrade OpenTofu in CI and on laptops. |

## 🟡 Worth a look

| Release | What changed | Relevant if you |
|---|---|---|
| [Kubernetes 1.36](https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/10/08/kubernetes-v1-36/) | Sidecar containers are stable and the last deprecated admission flags are removed. | run your own clusters or maintain Helm charts. |
| [Ollama 0.14](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.14.0) | Model files can set a default seed, and the server reports memory use per model. | serve models locally and pin versions. |

## ⚪ Good to know

| Release | What changed |
|---|---|
| [Vitest 5.1](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/releases/tag/v5.1.0) | Browser mode starts faster and the default reporter prints slow tests. |
| [Node.js 24.9](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.9.0) | A routine release with fixes to the test runner and the HTTP client. |
